## NYT::NFlow::TDynamicAsyncProcessorSpec {#NYT_NFlow_TDynamicAsyncProcessorSpec}

|| **Parameter** | **Description** ||
|| `max_running_tasks` | **Type**: [NYT::NYTree::TSize](./all_yson_structs#NYT_NYTree_TSize)
**Default value**: `100`
Maximum number of tasks of the processor that run at once. The other tasks wait in the processor, and swift timers are not taken while the limit is reached. ||
|| `max_ready_byte_size` | **Type**: [NYT::NYTree::TSize](./all_yson_structs#NYT_NYTree_TSize)
**Default value**: `64Mi`
Maximum byte size of the results that wait to be processed by an epoch. While the limit is reached, the processor starts no new tasks and swift timers are not taken. ||
|| `timeout` | **Type**: `std::optional<`[TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)`>`
A task that runs longer fails with a timeout error, and the error comes to the `Computation` as the result of the task. Without a timeout, a hung task holds its timer and its slot until the job restarts. A change applies to the tasks started after it. ||
|#
